searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — thirty additional improvements the awtsmoos renews the plan before the plan renews the page; awtsmoos.com gains speed when restraint and ambition become partners on one stage. 1. scope selectors by an actual route attribute already present in production html. 2. never introduce a wrapper solely to satisfy css scope when the body route marker already exists. 3. preserve existing design tokens; do not fork colors or spacing into apps only duplicates without need. 4. keep the apps manifest import only so stylesheet responsibilities remain visible. 5. route scope media query selectors too; media queries do not excuse global ownership. 6. put hover motion behind hover capable pointer media conditions. 7. preserve active feedback for touch even when hover is unavailable. 8. preserve focus visible outlines independently of hover animation. 9. ensure reduced motion rules remain route scoped and state equivalent. 10. keep sticky filter z index small and local; do not escalate it to solve unknown overlay issues. 11. verify sticky filter top offsets against the actual shell rather than inventing a new fixed header height. 12. do not add backdrop filter animation; keep mobile gpu work bounded. 13. avoid 100vw; use available containing block width and min width: 0 where spill is possible. 14. ensure grid tracks use minmax(0, ...) whenever content can contain long route/title text. 15. preserve content visibility optimization on cards while checking keyboard focus behavior. 16. keep catalog data immutable and separate from presentation. 17. do not put ai specific metadata into every visible app card; use progressive disclosure or docs links. 18. do not force kabbalistic terms into public labels or api verbs; internal poetry must not become usability tax. 19. make every new js lifecycle abortable if it registers route owned listeners. 20. keep dom construction through textcontent/native elements rather than unsafe html strings. 21. treat any global style scanner finding as a hypothesis until its stylesheet consumer is known. 22. exclude vendor/generated/minified styles from rewrite automation; report them separately. 23. rank global style findings by public reach and collision likelihood, not raw count. 24. rank overflow findings by narrowest supported mobile viewport first. 25. record z index with its local stacking context; a number alone does not prove a defect. 26. separate hidden advanced ui from essential navigation so disclosure cannot conceal the primary task. 27. prefer native for simple disclosure; use custom drawers only when lifecycle/focus semantics demand them. 28. verify docs links against actual files/routes before surfacing them in catalog ui. 29. re read recent animator files before any crosslink because that branch is actively landing its contract. 30. make the completion statement proportional to evidence: say which route families were changed and which were scanned, not “all pages fixed” without runtime proof. 31. add a regression proof that all apps local selectors include the route scope after rewrite. 32. test source line counts after rewrites so modularity remains measurable. 33. keep css comment poetry and architectural explanation; split files rather than deleting documentation. 34. use one source rewrite pass, then test; only perform a second source pass for observed deltas. 35. preserve existing catalog links exactly unless route validation proves one is dead. 36. if global docs already expose a machine manifest, link to it rather than inventing another endpoint. 37. if no global manifest exists, prefer a small manifest that references specialist manifests rather than one giant duplicated schema. 38. treat browser runtime screenshots as proof of geometry, not proof of keyboard/api behavior. 39. test keyboard and api behavior separately from visual verification. 40. leave durable remaining work nodes for high risk surfaces not yet runtime tested. final refinement the first concrete production change will be a full file route scope rewrite of the apps stylesheet family after every member is read. it will preserve current ux strengths while eliminating selector leakage and modality errors. the next evidence producing change will be a reusable static risk scan only if no equivalent tool already exists. animator remains a verification/crosslink target until its active implementation finishes.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — final source plan the awtsmoos is not revealed by noise but by exact vessels that let more light arrive; awtsmoos.com becomes futuristic when every boundary is deliberate, every control alive. production wave one: apps route isolation files to rewrite completely geelooy/apps/styles/base.css replace naked body ownership with body[data geelooy route="apps"]; route scope section hierarchy selectors; preserve current gradients, typography, and spacing. geelooy/apps/styles/filter.css route scope filter layout and controls; preserve full width, touch height, and focus visible behavior; add min width: 0 where form tracks need spill protection. geelooy/apps/styles/interactions.css route scope every control selector; preserve pointer qualified hover, touch active, focus visible, reduced motion. geelooy/apps/styles/cards.css route scope cards, icons, commerce badges, and transitions; move hover transform under hover capable fine pointer media; keep active and focus behavior available to keyboard/touch through their owning modules. geelooy/apps/styles/hero.css route scope hero, actions, note; preserve fluid type and bounded grid tracks; add containment safe minimum widths only if required by current rules. geelooy/apps/styles/discovery.css route scope sticky filter, catalog status, cards, focus, hidden/reduced motion rules; retain local z index 6 rather than escalating; keep mobile one column behavior. geelooy/apps/styles/responsive.css route scope all responsive selectors; preserve mobile first stacking, full width actions, and reduced motion behavior. files intentionally unchanged in wave one geelooy/apps/index.html: markup already has a stable route root and semantic search structure. geelooy/apps/scripts/apps filter.js: already tiny and documented. geelooy/apps/scripts/filter/appsfiltertiferesruntime.js: already class based, abortable, snapshot capable, and under the modular ceiling. catalog data/renderer: preserve until a real ux/data gap is measured. animator source: owned by a live concurrent final plan. production wave two: risk tooling inspect existing geelooy/tools, geelooy/tests, and script helpers for a css/public surface hygiene scanner. if absent, create a small read only scanner split into focused modules under an existing verification area. it must never rewrite files automatically. production wave three: evidence selected surfaces run the scanner, rank public defects, then inspect the highest risk pages completely before any rewrite. favor high reach route families and overlay/mobile hazards. agent/docs continuation inspect canonical global docs/api discovery while animator lands. after its agent facade is present, verify its manifest/install bridge and expose only truthful crosslinks from global docs/catalogs. verification contract after wave one source writes: 1. reread all seven css files completely; 2. verify every effective selector is apps route scoped; 3. verify no 100vw, uncontrolled width, or extreme z index was introduced; 4. browser test apps at 320px, 390px, and desktop; 5. keyboard focus search/select/cards; 6. inspect console; 7. verify reduced motion stylesheet path statically; 8. write planned vs actual delta; 9. only then perform a second source pass if evidence requires it.
